# Ametherian

> Ametherian is a proposed family of modular JavaScript and TypeScript libraries under the @foulfoxhacks npm scope, with a Node.js-first direction.

Ametherian is at the public proposal and planning stage. The packages and capabilities described here are proposed work, not claims of implemented, audited, or production-ready software.
